description: RUM con Grafana Faro: Web Vitals desde Loki (kind=measurement), red y excepciones como eventos. Loki, Tempo y el service.name usado en la tabla de trazas están fijos (datasources por defecto de la organización). Solo el filtro Application es visible. Las medias usan avg/quantile sobre el rango seleccionado — son representativas si hay tráfico estable; con pocas muestras pueden verse picos dispersos (scatter) en las series temporales. Trace ID en logs: los derived fields del datasource Loki enlazan a Tempo al abrir el detalle de una línea; en fetch suele haber ID, en excepciones capturadas con pushError a menudo no hay span activo (trace vacío es esperable).

panels.title: TTFB
panels.description: Time to First Byte — time from navigation start until the browser receives the first byte from the server. Good: <800ms, Poor: >1800ms.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_ttfb > 0 | unwrap value_ttfb | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: FCP
panels.description: First Contentful Paint — time until the browser renders the first piece of content (text, image, etc). Good: <1800ms, Poor: >3000ms.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_fcp > 0 | unwrap value_fcp | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: LCP
panels.description: Largest Contentful Paint — time until the largest visible element is rendered. This is the main indicator of perceived load speed. Good: <2500ms, Poor: >4000ms.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_lcp > 0 | unwrap value_lcp | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: CLS
panels.description: Cumulative Layout Shift — measures visual stability. How much the page layout shifts unexpectedly during loading. Good: <0.1, Poor: >0.25. Lower is better.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | unwrap value_cls | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: FID
panels.description: First Input Delay — time from when the user first interacts (click, tap) until the browser can respond. Good: <100ms, Poor: >300ms.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_fid > 0 | unwrap value_fid | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: INP
panels.description: Interaction to Next Paint — measures responsiveness to all user interactions throughout the page lifecycle. Replaces FID as the primary responsiveness metric. Good: <200ms, Poor: >500ms.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_inp > 0 | unwrap value_inp | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Page Load Over Time (TTFB / FCP / LCP)
panels.description: p75 de métricas por intervalo (scatter si hay pocas muestras por bucket). TTFB = respuesta del servidor; FCP / LCP = primera pintura y contenido principal.

targets.expr: avg(quantile_over_time(0.75, {source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_ttfb > 0 | unwrap value_ttfb | __error__="" [$__interval]))
avg(quantile_over_time(0.75, {source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_fcp > 0 | unwrap value_fcp | __error__="" [$__interval]))
avg(quantile_over_time(0.75, {source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_lcp > 0 | unwrap value_lcp | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Layout Shift Over Time (CLS)
panels.description: Cumulative Layout Shift over time. Spikes indicate moments where the page layout shifted unexpectedly (e.g. images loading without dimensions, ads injecting).

targets.expr: avg(quantile_over_time(0.75, {source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | unwrap value_cls | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Input Delay Over Time (FID / INP)
panels.description: How long users wait after interacting with the page. FID measures only the first interaction, INP measures all interactions. Lower is better.

targets.expr: avg(quantile_over_time(0.75, {source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_fid > 0 | unwrap value_fid | __error__="" [$__interval]))
avg(quantile_over_time(0.75, {source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | value_inp > 0 | unwrap value_inp | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Total Exceptions
panels.description: Total number of JavaScript exceptions captured by Faro in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="exception" | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Exceptions Over Time
panels.description: Rate of JavaScript exceptions. Spikes indicate regressions or broken functionality.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="exception" | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Exception Details
panels.description: Errores reportados con pushError. El trace ID solo aparece si había un span de tracing activo; el botón de prueba captura el error en un try/catch sin span, por eso suele verse traceID vacío (datos correctos, no un fallo del pipeline). Para correlacionar, use errores durante navegación/fetch instrumentados. Abrir el detalle de la línea para ver el enlace ‘View Trace’ del datasource Loki si hay ID.

targets.expr: {source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="exception" | __error__="" | line_format "{{.type}}: {{.value}} | traceID={{if .traceID}}{{.traceID}}{{else if .traceId}}{{.traceId}}{{else}}n/a{{end}}"

panels.title: Fetch Requests
panels.description: Number of fetch/XHR requests made by the frontend application over time.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="event" | event_name="faro.tracing.fetch" | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: HTTP Status Codes
panels.description: Distribution of HTTP response status codes from fetch/XHR requests. Watch for 4xx/5xx spikes.

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_http_status_code) (count_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="event" | event_name="faro.tracing.fetch" | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Fetch latency (p95)
panels.description: Duración del span cliente de fetch (Faro exporter: duration_ns en el JSON del evento). Valor en ms. Si no hay datos, el campo puede estar ausente en tu versión del SDK.

targets.expr: avg(quantile_over_time(0.95, {source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="event" | event_name="faro.tracing.fetch" | duration_ns > 0 | unwrap duration_ns | __error__="" [$__interval])) / 1e6

panels.title: Recent Requests
panels.description: Últimos fetch instrumentados: método, URL, estado, duración en ns (duration_ns) y traceID si existe. El texto de la línea no es clicable; use el panel de detalle de logs (icono) para ‘View Trace’ con el datasource Loki configurado.

targets.expr: {source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | kind="event" | event_name="faro.tracing.fetch" | __error__="" | line_format "{{.event_data_http_method}} {{.event_data_http_status_code}} {{.event_data_http_url}}{{if .duration_ns}} | {{.duration_ns}}ns{{end}} | traceID={{if .traceID}}{{.traceID}}{{else if .traceId}}{{.traceId}}{{else}}n/a{{end}}"

panels.title: Recent Traces
panels.description: Últimos traces que coinciden con resource.service.name en Tempo (debe alinear con app.name del SDK Faro). Ajuste la variable ‘Tempo service.name’ si usa otro nombre. Lista vía TraceQL; pulse una fila para abrir el trace.

panels.title: Events by Kind
panels.description: Distribution of event types: measurement (Web Vitals), event (fetch, navigation), exception (JS errors).

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Event Rate Over Time
panels.description: Rate of all Faro events by type. Useful to see overall frontend activity and correlate with exceptions.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({source="faro", app_name=~"$app"} | json | __error__="" [$__interval]))

title: Frontend RUM — Grafana Faro
